api.notes: SizeContext.Provider's value: sm, md, lg or null. Unset provides null.

hooks.notes: @tecton-astryx/core/context/keys.js; provided by tct-size-provider and by containers such as tct-button-group.
new SizeController(host, {explicit: () => this.size, fallback: 'md'}).value: explicit, then context, then default.

differences.text: Upstream exposed only the context (SizeContext.Provider, no component page). tct-size-provider is the element form: a size attribute instead of a value prop, display: contents, no shadow root.
A value outside sm, md, lg provides no size (null) and warns in dev mode, instead of passing the string through to controls.

requests.reason: Declares '*.light.css?inline' (CSS text for light-DOM sheets). Providers import their .light.css this way; the M6 light-dom.css generator globs the same files.
requests.diff: declare module '*.light.css?inline' { const css: string; export default css; }

requests.reason: New core base class TctProviderElement for the providers (no shadow root, no render output, adopts lightStyles). The same commit adds the shadow:false option to packages/testing runElementSuite.

core.size-provider.notes: Guides: [mwg:custom-elements] provider without a shadow root and display: contents; [mwg:styling-web-components] light-DOM sheet adopted once per root.
